newsitem.title: USA: Consumers 67 MW Mich. unit down 1-2 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Consumers 67 MW Mich. unit down 1-2 weeks.

text.p: Consumers Power Co's 67 megawatt Big Rock Point nuclear power plant should resume production in one to two weeks after being taken off line Wednesday for repairs, a company spokesman said.
"We expect (repair work) will take one to two weeks," company spokesman Tim Petrosky said Thursday.
The unit was taken off line Wednesday when an error was found in a computer program which regulates the maximum temperature under which equipment may operate at the plant, Petrosky said.
The Charlevoix, Mich., plant is wholly owned and operated by Consumers Power, a subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp.
Big Rock Point accounts for one percent of Consumers Power's installed generating capacity.
